title: Changelog & Updates
subtitle: Track the latest updates, feature releases, and bug fixes across all VibePress Studio products.

changes: Replaced all low-contrast Blue (from-blue-600) and Black (from-slate-800/900/950, bg-slate-950) button/gradient backgrounds with high-contrast brand gradients from-primary to-indigo-600 and from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 (page.tsx product headers, products roadmap teaser, shelfmaster licensing, about commitment banner).

Fixed button text legibility: removed opacity-80/90, changed bg-white/10 and bg-white/20 translucent pills to solid bg-white text-primary (v0.2.2 badges, global CTA, roadmap pill, product category labels).
Unified CTAs to bg-primary text-primary-foreground (shelfmaster hero + bottom CTA, readiness badge) and improved FREE/PRO badges (blue-600 → primary, indigo-600 → violet-600) for WCAG AA+ contrast.
Verified build and Vercel deployment live at https://vibepressstudio.vercel.app
Added dual membership KYC feature for waived privilege accounts.
Optimized SQLite query execution reducing RAM usage by 15%.
Fixed an issue with 58mm thermal printer alignment on Linux.
Official launch of the VibePress Studio platform.
Initial release of Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker Pro.
